Site Reliability Engineer – Platform Team
Cloudnest GmbH · Berlin or Remote (EU time zones)

What you'll do
• Operate our multi-tenant k8s clusters on AWS (EKS)
• Codify infrastructure with Terraform and Helm
• Improve our CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Argo CD)
• Participate in our on-call rotation (one week in six)

What you bring
• 4+ years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering
• Production experience with Kubernetes and Terraform
• In-depth knowledge of AWS networking and IAM
• Strong Linux fundamentals
• Experience building CI/CD pipelines
• Scripting in Python or Bash
• Go experience, Prometheus/Grafana or a CKA certification are a bonus

Perks
• €80k–€100k plus stock options
• On-call bonus and €2,000 conference budget
• Relocation support to Berlin, Urban Sports Club / Gym membership

Cloudnest is an equal opportunity employer.
Apply via careers@cloudnest.example
